units.en: King Han issued an order: For soldiers who unfortunately die, officials shall provide burial clothes, coffins, and shrouds, and transport them home.
units.literal: King Han issued an order: For soldiers who unfortunately die, officials shall provide burial clothes, coffins, and shrouds, and transport them home.

units.zh: 漢王欲西歸，張良、陳平諫曰：「今漢有天下太半，而諸侯皆附，楚兵罷食盡，此天亡之時，不因其幾而遂取之，所謂養虎自遺患也。」
units.en: The King of Han wanted to return west. Zhang Liang and Chen Ping advised him: "Han now possesses more than half the realm, and all the feudal lords have attached themselves to it. Chu's troops are exhausted and its food is gone. This is the moment when Heaven is destroying Chu. If we do not seize this opportunity and take it, that is what is called raising a tiger and leaving disaster for oneself."
units.literal: King Han wanted to return west. Zhang Liang and Chen Ping advised: "Now Han possesses more than half the world, and all the feudal lords are attached. Chu troops are exhausted and food is finished. This is the time Heaven has doomed them. If we do not take advantage of this opportunity to destroy them, this is called raising a tiger that brings disaster to oneself."

units.zh: 孝文皇帝，高祖中子也，母曰薄姬。
units.en: Emperor Xiaowen was the middle son of Emperor Gaozu, born to Lady Bo.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaowen was Gaozu's middle son, his mother was named Lady Bo.

units.zh: 贊曰：孝文皇帝即位二十三年，宮室苑囿車騎服御無所增益。
units.en: The commentator states: Emperor Xiaowen reigned for twenty-three years without adding to the palaces, parks, carriages, horses, or furnishings.
units.literal: The commentator says: Emperor Xiaowen ascended the throne for twenty-three years, and the palaces, parks, carriages, horses, and furnishings were not increased at all.

units.zh: 高祖十一年，誅陳豨，定代地，立為代王，都中都。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, after executing Chen Xi and pacifying the Dai region, he was established as King of Dai with his capital at Zhongdu.
units.literal: In Gaozu's eleventh year, executed Chen Xi, pacified Dai territory, established as King of Dai, capital at Zhongdu.

units.zh: 皇帝即日夕入未央宮。
units.en: The emperor entered Weiyang Palace that same evening.
units.literal: That evening the emperor entered Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 遂即天子位。
units.en: He immediately ascended the imperial throne.
units.literal: He then immediately ascended the imperial throne.

units.zh: 七年夏六月己亥，帝崩于未央宮。
units.en: On the day Jihai in the sixth month of summer in the seventh year, the emperor passed away in Weiyang Palace.
units.literal: In the seventh year, summer, sixth month, day Jihai, the emperor died in Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 上曰： 「楚王，季父也，春秋高，閱天下之義理多矣，明於國家之體。
units.en: The emperor replied: 'The King of Chu is my uncle. Advanced in years and experienced in the world's moral principles, he understands the proper order of the state.
units.literal: The emperor said: 'The King of Chu is my uncle. He is advanced in age, has seen much of the world's principles and righteousness, understands the structure of the state.

units.zh: 吳王於朕，兄也；
units.en: The King of Wu is like an elder brother to me;
units.literal: The King of Wu is an elder brother to me;

units.zh: 淮南王，弟也：皆秉德以陪朕，豈為不豫哉！
units.en: The King of Huainan is like a younger brother to me. All of them uphold virtue to support me—how could they not stand ready as successors!
units.literal: The King of Huainan is my younger brother: all uphold virtue to assist me, how could they not be prepared!

units.zh: 子啟最長，敦厚慈仁，請建以為太子。」
units.en: Prince Qi is the eldest son, honest and sincere, kind and benevolent. We petition to establish him as crown prince.'
units.literal: Prince Qi is the eldest, honest, kind, and benevolent. We petition to establish him as crown prince.'

units.zh: 皇太后曰：「立太子母竇氏為皇后。」
units.en: The Empress Dowager declared: 'Establish Lady Dou, mother of the crown prince, as empress.'
units.literal: The Empress Dowager said: 'Establish the crown prince's mother Lady Dou as empress.'

units.zh: 因立皇子武為代王，參為太原王，揖為梁王。
units.en: As a result, he established his sons Wu as King of Dai, Can as King of Taiyuan, and Yi as King of Liang.
units.literal: Consequently he established the imperial princes Wu as King of Dai, Can as King of Taiyuan, and Yi as King of Liang.

units.zh: 身衣弋綈，所幸慎夫人衣不曳地，帷帳無文繡，以示敦朴，為天下先。
units.en: He himself wore coarse silk garments, and his favored Lady Shen's robes did not trail on the ground. The curtains and canopies lacked embroidered patterns, demonstrating frugality and setting an example for the world.
units.literal: He himself wore coarse silk, and the favored Lady Shen's robes did not drag on the ground; the curtains and canopies had no embroidered patterns, to demonstrate frugality and lead the world by example.

units.zh: 丞相陳平、太尉周勃、朱虛侯劉章等共誅之，謀立代王。
units.en: Chancellor Chen Ping, Grand Commandant Zhou Bo, the Marquis of Zhuxu Liu Zhang, and others joined together to execute the Lü clan and plotted to establish the King of Dai on the throne.
units.literal: Chancellor Chen Ping, Grand Commandant Zhou Bo, Marquis of Zhuxu Liu Zhang and others together executed them, plotted to establish the King of Dai.

units.zh: 大臣遂使人迎代王。
units.en: The ministers then dispatched envoys to welcome the King of Dai.
units.literal: The ministers then sent people to welcome the King of Dai.

units.zh: 今已誅諸呂，新喋血京師，以迎大王為名，實不可信。
units.en: Now that the Lü clan has been executed and the capital still runs with fresh blood, their claim of welcoming Your Majesty is utterly untrustworthy.
units.literal: Now that the Lü clan has been executed and the capital is fresh with blood, using the name of welcoming Your Majesty, it is truly not trustworthy.

units.zh: 願稱疾無往，以觀其變。」
units.en: We urge Your Majesty to feign illness and decline to go, so that we may observe how the situation develops.'
units.literal: We wish you would feign illness and not go, to observe how things change.'

units.zh: 方今高帝子獨淮南王與 大王，大王又長，賢聖仁孝，聞於天下，故大臣因天下之心而欲迎立大王，大王勿疑也。」
units.en: Of Emperor Gaozu's surviving sons, only the King of Huainan and Your Majesty remain. You are the elder brother, renowned throughout the empire for your virtue, wisdom, benevolence, and filial piety. The ministers, following the will of the people, wish to welcome you as emperor. Do not doubt this.'
units.literal: Nowadays among Gaozu's sons only the King of Huainan and Your Majesty remain. Your Majesty is also the eldest, virtuous, sage-like, benevolent and filial, renowned throughout the world. Therefore the ministers, following the will of the world, desire to welcome and establish Your Majesty. Your Majesty should not doubt this.'

units.zh: 代王報太后，計猶豫未定。
units.en: The King of Dai informed the Empress Dowager, but his plans remained uncertain and unresolved.
units.literal: The King of Dai reported to the Empress Dowager; his plans were hesitant and undecided.

units.zh: 代王曰：「寡人固已為王，又何王乎？」
units.en: The King of Dai replied: 'I am already a king—what greater kingship could there be?'
units.literal: The King of Dai said: 'I am already a king, what more kingship is there?'

units.zh: 卜人曰：「所謂天王者，乃天子也。」
units.en: The diviner explained: 'The heavenly king of which I speak is none other than the emperor himself.'
units.literal: The diviner said: 'What is called heavenly king is precisely the Son of Heaven.'

units.zh: 於是代王乃遣太后弟薄昭見太尉勃，勃等具言所以迎立王者。
units.en: At this the King of Dai dispatched Bo Zhao, the Empress Dowager's younger brother, to meet with Grand Commandant Zhou Bo. Zhou Bo and his colleagues explained in detail the reasons for welcoming and enthroning the king.
units.literal: Thereupon the King of Dai sent the Empress Dowager's younger brother Bo Zhao to see Grand Commandant Zhou Bo; Zhou Bo and the others fully explained the reasons for welcoming and establishing the king.

units.zh: 代王笑謂宋昌曰：「果如公言。」
units.en: The King of Dai smiled and told Song Chang: 'Just as you predicted.'
units.literal: The King of Dai smiled and said to Song Chang: 'Indeed as you said.'

units.zh: 昌還報，代王乃進至渭橋。
units.en: Song Chang returned with his report, and the King of Dai then proceeded to Wei Bridge.
units.literal: Chang returned and reported; the King of Dai then advanced to Wei Bridge.

units.zh: 群臣拜謁稱臣，代王下拜。
units.en: The assembled ministers bowed low and acknowledged him as their sovereign. The King of Dai returned the courtesy with a bow.
units.literal: The ministers bowed and paid respects, calling themselves subjects. The King of Dai descended and bowed.

units.zh: 代王謝曰：「至邸而議之。」
units.en: The King of Dai politely declined, saying: "Let us discuss this when we reach the residence."
units.literal: The King of Dai declined, saying: "Let us discuss it when we reach the residence."

units.zh: 臣謹請陰安侯、頃王后、琅邪王、列侯、吏二千石議，大王高皇帝子，宜為嗣。
units.en: We ministers respectfully requested deliberation by the Marquis of Yin'an, the queen dowager of King Qing, the King of Langye, the ranked marquises, and officials of two thousand shi. They agree that Your Majesty, as a son of Emperor Gao, should be the successor.
units.literal: We ministers respectfully request that the Marquis of Yin'an, the Queen Dowager of King Qing, the King of Langye, the ranked marquises, and officials of two thousand shi deliberate. Your Majesty is a son of Emperor Gao and should be the successor.

units.zh: 願大王即天子位。」
units.en: We wish Your Majesty to immediately ascend the imperial throne."
units.literal: We wish Your Majesty to immediately ascend the imperial throne."

units.zh: 代王曰：「奉高帝宗廟，重事也。
units.en: The King of Dai said: "Serving at Emperor Gao's ancestral temple is a grave matter.
units.literal: The King of Dai said: "Serving at Emperor Gao's ancestral temple is a grave matter.

units.zh: 代王西鄉讓者三，南鄉讓者再。
units.en: The King of Dai declined three times while facing west and twice while facing south.
units.literal: The King of Dai declined three times while facing west and twice while facing south.

units.zh: 丞相平等皆曰：「臣伏計之，大王奉高祖宗廟最宜稱，雖天下諸侯萬民皆以為宜。
units.en: Chancellor Ping and the others said: "We ministers have considered this carefully. Your Majesty is most fitting and worthy to serve at Emperor Gao's ancestral temple, and the feudal lords and people throughout the realm all agree.
units.literal: Chancellor Ping and the others all said: "We ministers have considered this carefully. Your Majesty is most fitting and worthy to serve at Emperor Gao's ancestral temple, and the feudal lords and myriad people throughout the realm all consider it fitting.

units.zh: 願大王幸聽臣等。
units.en: We beg Your Majesty to hear your ministers.
units.literal: May Your Majesty graciously hear your ministers.

units.zh: 代王曰：「宗室將相王列侯以為其宜寡人，寡人不敢辭。」
units.en: The King of Dai said: "The imperial clan, generals, chancellors, kings, and marquises all consider me the suitable one. I do not dare decline."
units.literal: The King of Dai said: "The imperial clan, generals, chancellors, kings, and marquises all consider me the suitable one. I do not dare decline."

units.zh: 元年冬十月辛亥，皇帝見于高廟。
units.en: On the xinhai day of the tenth month of winter in the first year, the emperor appeared at Gaozu's ancestral temple.
units.literal: On the xinhai day of the tenth month of winter in the first year, the emperor appeared at the Gao ancestral temple.

units.zh: 上乃許之。
units.en: The emperor then gave his approval.
units.literal: The emperor then consented.

units.zh: 乃脩代來功。
units.en: He then recompensed the merits earned during his time as King of Dai.
units.literal: He then rewarded the merits from the time in Dai.

units.zh: 上幸甘泉，遣丞相灌嬰擊匈奴，匈奴去。
units.en: The emperor journeyed to Ganquan and sent Chancellor Guan Ying to attack the Xiongnu invaders, who then retreated.
units.literal: The emperor traveled to Ganquan and dispatched Chancellor Guan Ying to attack the Xiongnu; the Xiongnu withdrew.

units.zh: 上自甘泉之高奴，因幸太原，見故群臣，皆賜之。
units.en: The emperor traveled from Ganquan to Gaonu, then proceeded to Taiyuan where he met his old ministers and bestowed gifts upon them all.
units.literal: The emperor went from Ganquan to Gaonu, and then proceeded to Taiyuan, where he met with his former ministers and granted gifts to all of them.

units.zh: 濟北王興居聞帝之代，欲自擊匈奴，乃反，發兵欲襲滎陽。
units.en: King Xingju of Jibei learned that the emperor was on his tour in Dai territory. He wanted to lead his own campaign against the Xiongnu, but instead he rebelled and mobilized troops to attack Xingyang.
units.literal: King Xingju of Jibei heard that the emperor was on his tour in Dai, desired to personally attack the Xiongnu, but instead rebelled, mobilizing troops to attack Xingyang.

units.zh: 秋七月，上自太原至長安。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, the emperor returned to Chang'an from Taiyuan.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, the emperor returned from Taiyuan to Chang'an.

units.zh: 春正月，上自代還。
units.en: In the first month of spring, the emperor returned from Dai.
units.literal: Spring, first month, the emperor returned from Dai.

units.zh: 上親勞軍，勒兵，申教令，賜吏卒。
units.en: The emperor personally inspected the troops, conducted military drills, reinforced the orders, and distributed rewards to the officers and soldiers.
units.literal: The emperor personally reviewed the troops, drilled the soldiers, reiterated the orders, and rewarded the officers and soldiers.

units.zh: 皇太后固要上，乃止。
units.en: The Empress Dowager firmly prevented the emperor from going, and so he abandoned the plan.
units.literal: The Empress Dowager firmly restrained the emperor, and so he stopped.

units.zh: 上乃下詔議郊祀。
units.en: The emperor then issued an edict calling for deliberation on suburban sacrifices.
units.literal: The emperor then issued an edict to deliberate on the suburban sacrifices.

units.zh: 夏四月，上幸雍，始郊見五帝，赦天下，修名山大川嘗祀而絕者，有司以歲時致禮。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, the emperor traveled to Yong and began the suburban sacrifices to the Five Emperors. He granted amnesty to the entire empire and restored the seasonal sacrifices to famous mountains and great rivers that had lapsed, with officials performing the rites at the proper times.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month: The emperor traveled to Yong, began the suburban sacrifices to meet the Five Emperors, granted amnesty to the world, and restored the seasonal sacrifices to famous mountains and great rivers that had been discontinued, with the officials performing the rites at the appropriate times.

units.zh: 九月，詔諸侯王公卿郡守舉賢良能直言極諫者，上親策之，傅納以言。
units.en: In the ninth month, he commanded feudal lords, nobles, ministers, and commandery governors to recommend worthy individuals capable of speaking frankly and offering bold criticism. The emperor personally examined them and accepted their counsel.
units.literal: Ninth month: He commanded the feudal lords, nobles, ministers, and commandery governors to recommend worthy and good men capable of speaking directly and offering extreme remonstrance; the emperor personally examined them and accepted their words.

units.zh: 十六年夏四月，上郊祀五帝于渭陽。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer in the sixteenth year, the emperor performed suburban sacrifices to the Five Emperors at Weiyang.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, summer, fourth month, the emperor performed suburban sacrifices to the Five Emperors at Wei Yang.

units.zh: 上曰：「百金，中人十家之產也。
units.en: The emperor said: 'One hundred jin represents the combined wealth of ten middle-class families.
units.literal: The emperor said: 'One hundred jin is the property of ten middle-class families.

units.zh: 南越尉佗自立為帝，召貴佗兄弟，以德懷之，佗遂稱臣。
units.en: Wei Tuo of Nanyue proclaimed himself emperor. The emperor summoned and honored Tuo's brothers, winning Tuo over with virtuous conduct, whereupon Tuo submitted as a vassal.
units.literal: Nanyue's Wei Tuo established himself as emperor; he summoned and honored Tuo's brothers, and won Tuo over with virtue, whereupon Tuo submitted as a vassal.

units.zh: 吳王詐病不朝，賜以几杖。
units.en: The King of Wu feigned illness and failed to attend court. The emperor granted him a table and staff as symbols of his advanced age.
units.literal: King of Wu feigned illness and did not attend court; he granted him a table and staff.

units.zh: 張武等受賂金錢，覺，更加賞賜，以媿其心。
units.en: Zhang Wu and others accepted bribes of gold and cash. When this was discovered, the emperor instead increased their rewards to shame their consciences.
units.literal: Zhang Wu and others accepted bribes of gold and cash; when discovered, he instead increased their rewards to shame their hearts.

units.zh: 孝文時，吳太子入見，得侍皇太子飲博。
units.en: In Emperor Wen’s reign the crown prince of Wu attended court and was allowed to drink and play liubo with the imperial heir.
units.literal: Under Emperor Xiaowen the Wu heir came to court and was admitted to drink and play liubo with the heir apparent.

units.zh: 博爭道，不恭，皇太子引博局提吳太子，殺之。
units.en: They quarreled over the rules; the Wu heir showed disrespect, and the crown prince seized the heavy board and struck him dead.
units.literal: A dispute over a move in the game turned disrespectful; the imperial heir snatched up the gaming board and dashed it against the Wu prince, killing him.

units.zh: 朝錯為太子家令，得幸皇太子，數從容言吳過可削。
units.en: Chao Cuo was serving as household steward to the crown prince and had won his favor. He repeatedly said in private that Wu's offenses gave grounds for reducing its territory.
units.literal: Chao Cuo served as household steward to the crown prince. Favored by the crown prince, he repeatedly said in private that Wu's offenses could be grounds for reducing its territory.

units.zh: 及景帝即位，錯為御史大夫，說上曰：「昔高帝初定天下，昆弟少，諸子弱，大封同姓，故孽子悼惠王王齊七十二城，庶弟元王王楚四十城，兄子王吳五十餘城。
units.en: When Emperor Jing came to the throne, Chao Cuo became Imperial Counselor. He urged the emperor, "When Gaozu first settled the realm, he had few brothers and his sons were young, so he gave large fiefs to men of his own surname. Thus King Daohui, his son by a concubine, ruled Qi with seventy-two cities; King Yuan, his younger half-brother, ruled Chu with forty cities; and his nephew ruled Wu with more than fifty cities.
units.literal: When Emperor Jing took the throne, Cuo became Grandee Secretary. He urged the emperor, "When Gaozu first settled the realm, his brothers were few and his sons were young, so he made large grants to men of his own surname. Thus King Daohui, his son by a concubine, ruled Qi with seventy-two cities; King Yuan, his younger half-brother, ruled Chu with forty cities; and his elder brother's son ruled Wu with more than fifty cities.

units.zh: 孝景前三年正月甲子，初起兵於廣陵。
units.en: On jiǎzǐ in the first month of Xiaojing’s third year the rebellion opened at Guangling.
units.literal: On the jiǎzǐ day of the first month in the third year of Emperor Xiaojing, he first raised troops at Guangling.

units.zh: 七國反書聞，天子乃遣太尉條侯周亞夫將三十六將軍往擊吳楚；
units.en: News of the seven kingdoms’ revolt reached court; the emperor sent Grand Commandant Zhou Yafu of Tiaohou with thirty-six generals against Wu and Chu;
units.literal: When word of the seven states' rebellion reached the throne, the Son of Heaven dispatched Grand Commandant Marquis of Tiaohou Zhou Yafu with thirty-six generals to strike Wu and Chu;

units.zh: 陛下多病志逸，不能省察。
units.en: The Son of Heaven is sick in body and distracted in will; he cannot see through the plot.
units.literal: The sovereign is often ill in mind and body and cannot look into these matters.

units.zh: 二月，吳王兵既破，敗走，於是天子制詔將軍：「蓋聞為善者天報以福，為非者天報以殃。
units.en: In the second month Wu’s army was shattered; the emperor told his generals: “Heaven crowns virtue with fortune and strikes evil with woe.
units.literal: In the second month the King of Wu's army had already been broken and fled in defeat; the Son of Heaven then issued an edict to the generals: “We have heard that Heaven rewards the good with blessing and the wicked with calamity.

units.zh: 王頓首膝行對曰：「今者，朝錯天子用事臣，變更高皇帝法令，侵奪諸侯地。
units.en: On his knees Ang said, “Chao Cuo rules the court, rewrites Gaozu’s statutes, and gnaws at princely fiefs.
units.literal: The king, knocking his head and crawling on his knees, replied, “At present Chao Cuo is the minister in charge at the Son of Heaven's side; he has altered the laws of the August Emperor Gaozu and seized the princes' lands.

units.zh: 又使使愬條侯於上，上使告條侯救梁，又守便宜不行。
units.en: They complained to the throne; the emperor told him to relieve Liang, yet he clung to his plan and stayed put.
units.literal: They also sent envoys to denounce Zhou Yafu to the emperor; the emperor ordered him to save Liang, yet he still held to tactical advantage and did not move.

units.zh: 及後使人為秋請，上復責問吳使者。
units.en: Later, when Wu sent an envoy for the autumn audience, the emperor again questioned and rebuked him.
units.literal: Later, when Wu sent a man for the autumn audience, the emperor again questioned and rebuked the Wu envoy.

units.zh: 於是天子皆赦吳使者歸之，而賜吳王几杖，老，不朝。
units.en: The Son of Heaven pardoned the envoys and sent them back, then gave the king of Wu a folding stool and staff in token of old age, freeing him from court calls.
units.literal: The emperor pardoned Wu’s envoys and sent them home, then bestowed on the king of Wu an arm-rest and staff as tokens of age, exempting him from court attendance.

units.zh: 遣曲周侯酈寄擊趙，將軍欒布擊齊，大將軍竇嬰屯滎陽監齊趙兵。
units.en: he sent Li Ji, marquis of Quzhou, against Zhao and Luan Bu against Qi, while Grand General Dou Ying encamped at Xingyang to keep watch over the armies of Qi and Zhao.
units.literal: he sent Marquis Li Ji of Quzhou against Zhao and General Luan Bu against Qi; Grand General Dou Ying encamped at Xingyang to keep watch over the Qi and Zhao armies.

units.zh: 上從其議，遂斬錯。
units.en: The emperor accepted his counsel and had Chao Cuo executed.
units.literal: The emperor accepted his counsel and had Chao Cuo executed.

units.zh: 高皇帝親垂功德，建立諸侯，幽王、悼惠王絕無後，孝文皇帝哀憐加惠，王幽王子遂，悼惠王子卬等，令奉其先王宗廟，為漢藩國，德配天地，明並日月。
units.en: Gaozu established the kingdoms. When the lines of King You of Zhao and King Daohui of Qi had been cut off, Emperor Wen compassionately made You’s son Sui, Daohui’s son Ang, and others kings so that they could tend their forefathers’ shrines and serve as Han’s outer bulwarks. His virtue matched Heaven and Earth, and his brilliance equaled the sun and moon.
units.literal: The August Emperor Gaozu personally bestowed merit and virtue by establishing the princes. When the lines of King You of Zhao and King Daohui of Qi had been cut off without successors, Emperor Xiaowen took pity and extended his grace, making King You's son Sui, King Daohui's son Ang, and others kings so that they could maintain their forefathers' ancestral temples and serve as Han's outer bulwarks—his virtue matched Heaven and Earth, and his brilliance equaled the sun and moon.

units.zh: 而吳王濞背德反義，誘受天下亡命罪人，亂天下幣，稱疾不朝二十餘年。
units.en: Yet Liu Bi spurned virtue, drew in fugitives, disrupted the currency, and for more than twenty years pleaded illness and stayed away from court.
units.literal: Yet the King of Wu Liu Bi turned his back on virtue and violated righteousness, enticed and harbored fugitive criminals from the realm, threw the realm's currency into confusion, and for more than twenty years claimed illness and did not attend court.

units.zh: 有司數請濞罪，孝文皇帝寬之，欲其改行為善。
units.en: Officials begged his head; Wendi spared him, hoping he would mend his ways.
units.literal: The authorities repeatedly requested Bi's punishment; Emperor Xiaowen was lenient and wished him to change his conduct for the good.

units.zh: 今乃與楚王戊、趙王遂、膠西王卬、濟南王辟光、菑川王賢、膠東王雄渠約從謀反，為逆無道，起兵以危宗廟，賊殺大臣及漢使者，迫劫萬民，伐殺無罪，燒殘民家，掘其丘壟，甚為虐暴。
units.en: Now he has allied with Liu Wu of Chu, Liu Sui of Zhao, Liu Ang of Jiaoxi, Liu Piguang of Jinan, Liu Xian of Zichuan, and Liu Xiongqu of Jiaodong to plot rebellion. These lawless traitors menace the temples, murder ministers and envoys, coerce the people, kill the innocent, burn their homes, and dig open their graves. Their cruelty is monstrous.
units.literal: Now he has joined with Liu Wu, king of Chu, Liu Sui, king of Zhao, Liu Ang, king of Jiaoxi, Liu Piguang, king of Jinan, Liu Xian, king of Zichuan, and Liu Xiongqu, king of Jiaodong, in an alliance to plot rebellion. Lawless in their treason, they raised troops to endanger the ancestral temples, murdered great ministers and Han envoys, coerced the people, slaughtered the innocent, burned commoners' homes, and dug open their tombs—utterly cruel and violent.

units.zh: 而卬等又重逆無道，燒宗廟，鹵御物，朕甚痛之。
units.en: Ang’s crew have burned the shrines and plundered the palace stores—Our heart is torn.
units.literal: Yet Ang and the others have again been utterly lawless, burned the temples, looted the imperial gear—the pain of this is great in Us.

units.zh: 朕素服避正殿，將軍其勸士大夫擊反虜。
units.en: We wear mourning and quit the main hall—generals, drive your men at the traitors.
units.literal: We have donned plain dress and avoided the main hall; generals, urge your officers to strike the rebels.

units.zh: 擊反虜者，深入多殺為功，斬首捕虜比三百石以上皆殺，無有所置。
units.en: Advance deep and kill many to earn merit; execute every captured rebel of three-hundred-picul rank or higher, sparing none.
units.literal: Those who strike the rebels shall take deep advances and heavy killing as merit; every captured rebel of the three-hundred-picul rank or above shall be put to death, with none spared.

units.zh: 敢有議詔及不如詔者，皆要斬。」
units.en: Debate the decree or disobey it—death by waist chop.”
units.literal: Whoever dares debate the edict or fail to match the edict—waist cut in two.”

units.zh: 高曰：「御史大夫朝錯熒惑天子，侵奪諸侯，蔽忠塞賢，朝廷疾怨，諸侯皆有背叛之意，人事極矣。
units.en: Ying Gao said, “Grandee Secretary Chao Cuo dazzles the Son of Heaven, strips the feudatories, blocks the loyal and worthy, so that the court boils with anger and every prince nurses rebellion. The crisis is complete.
units.literal: Gao answered, “Grandee Secretary Chao Cuo dazzles the sovereign, carves up the princes, silences loyal men and worthy advisors, until both court and kingdoms seethe with resentment and every prince harbors thoughts of revolt. Human patience is stretched to the limit.

units.zh: 召入見，上問以吳楚之計，盎對曰：「吳楚相遺書，曰『賊臣朝錯擅適諸侯，削奪之地』，以故反，名為西共誅錯，復故地而罷。
units.en: Yuan Ang was summoned to audience, and the emperor asked him about the plans of Wu and Chu. Ang replied, "Wu and Chu have exchanged letters saying, 'The wicked minister Chao Cuo has arbitrarily punished the feudal lords and stripped away their lands.' That is why they have rebelled. Their stated aim is to march west together, execute Chao Cuo, restore their former territories, and then disband.
units.literal: Ang was summoned to audience. The emperor asked him about the Wu-Chu situation. Ang replied, "Wu and Chu have sent each other messages saying, 'The wicked minister Chao Cuo has wantonly punished the feudal lords and seized their lands.' For this reason they have rebelled, claiming to execute Chao Cuo together from the west and then restore their former territories and disband.

units.zh: 定齊三年，聞漢將韓信引兵且東擊齊，齊使華毋傷、田解軍歷下以距漢。
units.en: Three years after Qi had been settled, they heard that the Han general Han Xin was leading troops east to attack Qi. Qi therefore sent Hua Wushang and Tian Jie to encamp at Lixia and resist Han.
units.literal: After Qi had been settled for three years, they heard Han general Han Xin was leading troops east to attack Qi, so Qi sent Hua Wushang and Tian Jie to garrison Lixia against Han.

units.zh: 老父相后曰：「夫人天下貴人也。」
units.en: The old man read Empress Lü's face and said: "Madame, you are a noble person of the world."
units.literal: The old father read Empress Lü's face and said: "Madame is a noble person of the world."

units.zh: 審食其從太公、呂后間行，反遇楚軍，羽常置軍中以為質。
units.en: Shen Yiji escorted the Venerable Sire and Empress Lü along hidden paths, but they encountered Chu troops. Xiang Yu kept them with the army as hostages.
units.literal: Shen Yiji secretly escorted the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü, but encountered Chu troops. Xiang Yu constantly kept them in the army as hostages.

units.zh: 九月，歸太公、呂后，軍皆稱萬歲。
units.en: In the ninth month, he returned the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü. The army all shouted ten thousand years.
units.literal: In the ninth month, he returned the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü. The army all shouted ten thousand years.

units.zh: 酒罷，呂媼怒呂公曰：「公始常欲奇此女，與貴人。
units.en: After the wine ended, Lü Po angrily confronted Lü Gong: "You always said this daughter was exceptional and should marry someone noble.
units.literal: The wine ended, Lü Po became angry at Lü Gong and said: "You at first constantly wished to treat this daughter as exceptional, to match her with a noble person.

units.zh: 令相兩子，見孝惠帝，曰：「夫人所以貴者，乃此男也。」
units.en: He had him read the faces of the two children. When he saw Emperor Xiaohui, he said: "Madame's nobility comes from this male child."
units.literal: She had him read the faces of the two children; when he saw Emperor Xiaohui, he said: "Madame's nobility comes from this male child."

units.zh: 老父曰：「鄉者夫人兒子皆以君，君相貴不可言。」
units.en: The old man said: "Just now, Madame and the children all take after you. Your appearance shows nobility beyond words."
units.literal: The old father said: 'Just now, madam and the children were all judged noble because of you; your features show nobility beyond words.'

units.zh: 太尉周勃道太原入定代地，至馬邑，馬邑不下，攻殘之。
units.en: Grand marshal Zhou Bo took the Taiyuan route to pacify Dai territory, reaching Mayi. Mayi did not submit, so he attacked and devastated it.
units.literal: Grand marshal Zhou Bo took the Taiyuan route to pacify Dai territory, reaching Mayi. Mayi did not submit, so he attacked and devastated it.

units.zh: 周勃重厚少文，然安劉氏者必勃也，可令為太尉。」
units.en: Zhou Bo is steady and substantial but short on refinement. Yet the man who will secure the Liu clan must be Bo. He can be made Grand Marshal."
units.literal: Zhou Bo is solid and sincere but lacks refinement. However, the one who will secure the Liu clan must be Bo. Can make him grand marshal."

units.zh: 周勃定代，斬陳豨於當城。
units.en: Zhou Bo pacified Dai and beheaded Chen Xi at Dangcheng.
units.literal: Zhou Bo pacified Dai and beheaded Chen Xi at Dangcheng.

units.zh: 春二 月，使樊噲、周勃將兵擊綰。
units.en: In the second month of spring, he sent Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo to lead troops to attack Lu Wan.
units.literal: In the second month of spring, he sent Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo to lead troops to attack Lu Wan.

units.zh: 陳平、灌嬰將十萬守滎陽，樊噲、周勃將二十 萬定燕代，此聞帝崩，諸將皆誅，必連兵還鄉，以攻關中。
units.en: Chen Ping and Guan Ying are leading 100,000 men guarding Xingyang, and Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo are leading 200,000 pacifying Yan and Dai. If they hear that the emperor has died and that the generals are all being executed, they will surely join forces and return home to attack Guanzhong.
